_confirmed_against: https://sandbox-api.informdirect.co.uk - all three operations exercised successfully against a real company number
_note: Every path verified against the live sandbox, not guessed.
GET /companies and GET /companies/{companyNumber} both return the same
envelope: {"Companies": [ ... ]}. The company number must be the full
8-character form - an unpadded one is rejected with 400 'The company
Add and remove are collection actions carrying the number in the body,
not the path: POST /companies/add and PUT /companies/delete.
_what_the_api_does_not_return: company status, accounts year end, accounts filing deadline,
confirmation statement dates, incorporation date, officers,
shareholders, filing history. None of these exist on any endpoint.

_why: Probed live and confirmed 404: there are no officer, shareholder,
filing or accounts endpoints. The SA close-company check cannot leave
the browser. The client code for them is written and tested, so moving
an entry here into 'operations' is all it would take if they appear.

list_companies.description: Every company linked to the account. Confirmed.

get_company.description: One company by 8-character company number. Confirmed.

add_company.description: Link one company: {"CompanyNumber": "..."} plus optional "AuthenticationCode". Confirmed: 201 on success, 422 if already associated, 404 if Companies House does not know the number, 429 for a bulk payload. One at a time.

remove_company.description: Unlink one company: {"CompanyNumber": "..."}. Confirmed: 200 {"Message": "Company deleted."}; 404 if the company is not on the account. Note the verb is PUT, not DELETE - DELETE on this path returns 405 with allow: PUT.
